dsa_roadmap.baseline: LeetCode Top Interview 150 as the coverage baseline; organize new anchors by recurring pattern and prerequisites rather than original list order.
dsa_roadmap.anchor_cadence: New pattern anchors are scheduled on odd-numbered study days; even-numbered days consolidate with no new mandatory problem. D+3, D+7 and D+21 reviews from actual first-attempt dates fall on consolidation days. The even-day solve window cold-solves the weakest due anchor; remaining due items receive active recall in the final window. Same-day D recall is included.
dsa_roadmap.review_policy: Only actual first-attempt dates establish review due dates. Planned dates are forecasts. Up to three due anchors may share a consolidation day. Failed prerequisites or recall displace a new anchor; no overtime is added and no review is marked complete automatically.
dsa_roadmap.outside_baseline_bridge: LC 704 Binary Search on Day 25 is an explicit prerequisite bridge outside Top Interview 150; it does not create a second tracker.
